sentences.text: The gist of the prosecution case is that the marriage of CW-1 was solemnized with accused No.1 on 04-09-2008 .

At the time of marriage, the accused persons forcibly obtained 500 gms of gold ornaments, 15 kgs of silver articles and Rs. One lakhs cash towards purchase of clothes and thereafter the accused persons harassed complainant to bring two acres of land situated at Uttarahalli and transfer the land into the name of accused No.1.

When complainant refused to do so, the accused persons subjected her to cruelty physically and mentally and denied the child born to complainant out of wedlock with accused No.1 and the accused No.2 and 3 induced to do ill will acts.
Further, the accused No.1 criminally intimidated to do away with her life, if she failed to give divorce as she has filed a suit against accused for maintenance.

Based on the said first  3  C.C.No.13860/2015 information, a case in Crime No.20/2015 came to be registered against the Accused for the aforesaid offences .
 3. Accused were enlarged on bail.

After completion of the investigation, the Police-Sub-Inspector, Basavanagudi Women Police Station, Bangalore has filed this charge sheet against the Accused for the offence punishable U/s.506, 498A r/w/s 34 of IPC and Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.

On receipt of charge sheet, this court took the cognizance of the alleged offences and the prosecution papers was provided to the accused No.1 to 3 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

Before framing charge, an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offence was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused persons pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
During the trial of the case, the accused No.2 and 3 reported as dead and hence, case against them stood abated.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW1 witness and got marked Ex.P1 to P6 documents  4  C.C.No.13860/2015 and MO-1 was got marked.
The Statement of Accused No.1 as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., was recorded.
The accused No.1 denied the incriminating circumstances appearing against him.
The accused No.1 has not let in any oral or documentary evidence on his behalf.
6. Heard arguments on both sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following point arise for my determination :-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused caused physical and mental  cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry and  threatened her and thereby accused have committed the  offences punishable U/s.506, 498A r/w/s 34 of IPC and Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.?
 2) What Order?
 8.

 Point No.1.......In the Negative.

It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution will have to establish its case beyond all reasonable doubt.
In order to prove the same, the prosecution has examined one witness as PW1 and got marked Ex.P.1 to Ex.P6 documents.
5  C.C.No.13860/2015  10.CW-9 was examined as PW-1.
P.W.1 Kavitha G.M. P I has deposed in her examination in chief that on 19-02-2015 CW-1 appeared in the Station and gave written complaint.
Based on it she registered a case in crime No.20/2015 and submitted FIR to the court.

On the same day, she obtained wedding invitation,
marriage photo from the CW-1.
PW-1 further deposed that on 23-2-20215 at the place shown by CW-1, she conducted spot mahazar in the presence of CW 7 and 8 as per Ex.P.6, and recorded statements of CW 2 to 6.
Thereafter on completion of the investigation she submitted chargesheet against the accused.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is to be noted that CW-1 being the complainant, key and material witness has not turned up before court to depose about the incident.

Despite issuance of summons to other chargesheeted witnesses,
they failed to appear before court.
The only evidence of Investigating officer who was examined as PW-1 has deposed about investigation done by her
is only a formal in nature.

4 alleged offences.
In the absence of material witnesses, this court holds that the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the  6  C.C.No.13860/2015 accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:-

In the result, I proceed to pass the following:-
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred U/s.248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused NO.1 is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.506, 498A r/w/s 34 of IPC and Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
The bail bond and surety bonds executed by the accused shall remain in force for 6 months.
